description: This file defines the HomeActivity class, which serves as the main entry point of an Android TV application. It extends FragmentActivity to ensure TV compatibility, manages fragment transactions to host the HomeFragment, forwards key events to handle DPAD navigation, and provides a method to retrieve overscan safe insets for UI layout adjustments.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the TV app, hosting the HomeFragment and managing key events and layout safe zones.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the HomeFragment if no previous state exists.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles hardware key events, forwarding DPAD navigation keys to the HomeFragment if applicable.

methods.name: getOverscanSafeInsets
methods.description: Returns a Rect representing the safe paddings for overscan, based on standard margins configured in resources.
